items.title: How an ad network sells a campaign
steps: The advertiser books a campaign with the network
The network picks matching publisher sites
Ads are served across those sites
The network tracks impressions and clicks
The network pays publishers after taking its margin
items.why: The network collects from the advertiser and pays publishers after keeping its margin.

items.title: How a publisher joins an ad network
steps: The publisher applies to the network
The publisher adds the network’s code to the pages
The publisher is paid on schedule
items.why: Approval comes first, then code, tests and live ads.
